text:
```yaml
name: End-to-End Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v3
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        profile: minimal
        override: true

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '16'
        registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        npm install --prefix tests/e2e
        cargo build --release

    - name: Start Tavern server
      run: |
        ./target/release/tavern &
        sleep 10

    - name: Retrieve server public key
      id: get_key
      run: echo "::set-output name=key::$(curl -s http://localhost:8080/public_key)"

    - name: Compile Imixv2 agent
      run: |
        cd imixv2
        make

    - name: Start Imixv2 agent
      run: |
        ./imixv2 -key ${{ steps.get_key.outputs.key }} &

    - name: Run Playwright tests
      working-directory: tests/e2e
      run: npx playwright test

    - name: Clean up processes
      run: |
        pkill -f tavern
        pkill -f imixv2
```

This GitHub Actions workflow sets up the necessary environments, builds the required components, starts the Tavern server and Imixv2 agent, runs the end-to-end tests using Playwright, and cleans up the processes afterward.
